answer:
Tebesa Nemine was born on February 8, 1986, in **Delta State, Nigeria** (specifically from the Burutu Local Government area).

The Chief Judge of Delta State is **Justice Tessy O. Diai** (also referred to as Hon. Justice Theresa T. Obiajulu Ogochukwu Diai), who was appointed as Chief Judge following the retirement of previous judges. She began her tenure around May 24, 2021.
